result:
The fix is complete! The bug was on line 42 of `tally/invoice.py`:
- **Before:** `if self.units() > BULK_UNITS:` (discount only applied for MORE than 10 units)
- **After:** `if self.units() >= BULK_UNITS:` (discount applies at exactly 10 units or more)

This matches the test name "test_bulk_discount_starts_at_ten_units" which expects the discount to apply when there are exactly 10 units in the order.
